# Academic Research Skills for Hermes

> Hermes Agent skills for academic research, paper writing, peer review, and publication workflows.

## About

This fork adapts Academic Research Skills for Claude Code into a Hermes Agent skill layer. It provides four Hermes-native skills for deep research, academic paper writing, simulated peer review, and end-to-end research-to-publication pipelines.
